changeSet.sql: IF TYPE_ID(N'dbo.AssetFiltersTable') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TYPE [dbo].[AssetFiltersTable] AS TABLE( [FilterType] varchar(1) NOT NULL, [Operator] varchar(25) NULL, [TypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [OptionalIdentifier] varchar(50) NULL, [FilterValues] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [TypeID] ASC ) WITH (IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ) END
